about.title: HELLO
about.lead: Information Technology graduate from Kasetsart University, looking for an entry-level web, software or AI developer role, remote or hybrid.
body: I build web apps with Angular, Vue.js and React, and backends with Node.js, .NET and Laravel.
Working in Agile teams taught me to ship features, fix tricky bugs and test with real users. One kiosk UI went through five versions based on feedback and large-screen tests on site.

education.label: Education
education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology
education.note: GPA 3.64, Scholarship 5A (1/2023, 1/2025), Good Study Award, and an oral presentation rated Very Good at AUCC 2025.

points: Worked in a research team under a faculty advisor on invisible watermarking for Stable Diffusion images (DCT on the latent space).
Implemented Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) to replace the lab's random choice of embedding positions.
Benchmarked on 100 images under 12 attacks: average detection rose from 66.1% to 82.2% with image quality maintained (mixed-PSNR 30.12 vs 29.66 dB).
Built AI Booth Assistant, owning both the Node.js backend (Gemini Live API, WebSockets) and the Unity frontend.
Implemented RAG with a PDF-upload API that embeds product documents into MongoDB Atlas. Migrated to gemini-embedding-001 and re-embedded the knowledge base.
Fixed unresponsive voice input with streaming push-to-talk, and added session resumption to keep context past the Live API's 10-minute limit.
Worked in an Agile team with daily stand-ups.

items.name: AI Booth Assistant
items.summary: A real-time voice kiosk for exhibitions. Visitors talk to it and get answers grounded in the exhibitor's own product documents through RAG. Built during my Exzy internship.

items.name: VillageClubHouse
items.summary: A booking app for village clubhouse facilities such as badminton courts and meeting rooms. It checks available time slots and prevents double-booking. Admins review and approve requests.

items.name: Online Banking
items.summary: A simulated online banking web app with user login. Supports deposits, withdrawals and transfers with balance checking. Solo project, frontend to database.

items.name: Commonfee-management
items.summary: A village common-fee system with separate admin and resident sides. It issues invoices by email, records payments and shows fee balances.
